findings.text: follow-on: _probe_reading maps a probe window's length to its named clock with an inline literal {300: five_hour, 10080: seven_day}.get(int(minutes), primary), re-implementing a capability reckon/budget.py already owns (WINDOW_MINUTES_CLOCK at reckon/budget.py:2885 with _reported_window_clock at reckon/budget.py:2896, the same translation used at reckon/budget.py:867), and its own raw.values()/window_minutes iteration duplicates budget._quota_windows at reckon/budget.py:842; the addition duplicates rather than extends the owner, so the two readers can drift.

follow-on: the probe trigger is any(block.get(stale) ...) and _unknown_window at reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:309 always carries stale False, so a subscription account whose published reading is entirely absent or unknown is never probed; the publisher only refreshes an account that already carries a stale figure, leaving Jev and preflight reading an unknown account indefinitely.

follow-on: the manual end-to-end reading records codex, codex-astra and codex-luna with source rollout (a fresh 0.303 s observation, never probed) and the only live probe attempt is claude-opus, which failed with HTTP 403, so the fragment does not exhibit a successful refresh through the probe; the goal behaviour is demonstrated only against the stubbed probe in tests/test_publisher_refreshes_stale_windows.py, and the production default document could not be written under the worker fence.

follow-on: the head arm's log names revision a9899a9b5197b516dfa9b92adb925b85d477bd6c (the code commit) while the reviewed head is b8c3d413400caf02453ac0ded43fd6c7b19a694b (a docs-only commit on top), so the 151-passed result is evidence about the code at a9899a9b5 and is carried to the reviewed head only because the intervening commit changes a document and no source.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records base 145 passed EXIT=0 and head 151 passed EXIT=0, the negative control red (1 failed EXIT=1), its commit list and its three changed paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_publisher_refreshes_stale_windows.py reddens on the declared mutation (negative-control.log: test_stale_subscription_window_is_refreshed_once_for_its_account FAILED, probe_calls 0 != 1) and its assertions compare the published figure against an independently supplied probe answer (usedPercent 0.0 -> utilisation 0.0) and against the source reading (0.85 retained on failure), not against a value the test itself passes to the code.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded, not claimed: base-gate.log (revision 111a3fb70, 145 passed, EXIT=0) and head-gate-final.log (revision a9899a9b5, 151 passed, EXIT=0) both ran to their summary lines with no FAILED/ERROR lines, and the negative control reddens at EXIT=1; the gap is that a successful refresh is shown only against a stubbed probe, the one live probe attempt failed with HTTP 403, and the head log names a9899a9b5 rather than the reviewed head.
justifications.fit: the added names describe mechanism (publish_document, _probe_reading, _previous_probe_candidates, the probe claim block) and the docstrings explain why the probe is claimed before it runs; no added symbol, comment or filename carries a version, a plan label or an attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:583 publish_document detects a stale subscription window, calls the existing account probe through _backends.probe_budget at line 662, rate-limits it to one attempt per DEFAULT_STALE_SECONDS horizon (line 68) with a durable pre-written claim, and republishes the reading with source probe at line 671 while retaining the aged reading and a failure reason when the probe fails.
justifications.reuse: _probe_reading re-implements the minutes-to-clock translation and keyed-window normalisation that reckon/budget.py already owns (WINDOW_MINUTES_CLOCK at reckon/budget.py:2885, _reported_window_clock at reckon/budget.py:2896, _quota_windows at reckon/budget.py:842) rather than extending that owner; the probe itself is correctly reused via _backends.probe_budget, but the added reader duplicates an owned capability, which the rubric caps at 5.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff over 111a3fb70..b8c3d413 changes exactly docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/publisher-refreshes-stale-windows.html, reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py and tests/test_publisher_refreshes_stale_windows.py, all three inside the node's declared write paths.
